proposed.text: What is the minimum ultimate tensile strength of 6063-T6 aluminum alloy?
proposed.rationale: Per ASTM B221 and the Aluminum Association, 6063-T6 extrusions have a minimum ultimate tensile strength of 190 MPa (typical ~241 MPa). The 186 MPa value belongs to 6063-T5, not T6, and is a common exam trap. 90 MPa is roughly the tensile strength of commercially pure aluminum (1100), and 145 MPa sits in the 6063-T5 typical range. Source: ASTM B221 (https://www.astm.org/b0221-02.html); Aluminum Association material specs.
